gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the LiTime 24V 100Ah Smart ComFlex is natively compatible only with Victron today (LiTime lists SMA, Go Power and Growatt as a 'future remote adaptation' by OTA update). None states that its communicating bank tops out at 25.6V 1600Ah, which means up to 16 units in parallel and no 48V series stacking. LiTime's standard Bluetooth 24V 100Ah ($499.99) and Redodo 24V 100Ah ($469.99) are both rated for a maximum of 4P2S.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited pages and the top results. The cited solarpoweredproject.com comparison covers only 12V batteries and has no series/parallel limits or inverter communication at all. LiTime's cited Bluetooth product page gives 4P2S for that model but says nothing about ComFlex. The gesike.com US guide gives series/parallel limits only for GSIKE and has no ComFlex, Victron or Epoch content. LiTime's 'best Victron-compatible' blog (rank 4, not cited) gives '16P1S with communication; 4P4S standard' for the 12V 320Ah ComFlex only, not the 24V. It does not say that brands other than Victron are not yet supported. The gearranking.com and solarkithq.com pages did not load (SSL error and 404), so I could not check them.
decides: This narrows ChatGPT's 'LiTime ComFlex – best for compatible smart solar and inverter systems' pick. It fits a 24V Victron GX system (Cerbo GX over the BMS-CAN/VE.Can port at 500 kbit/s, RJ45 cable included per LiTime's 12V guide) or LiTime's own 24V inverter-charger. It is not a closed-loop match today for SMA, Growatt or Go Power, and its stated communicating expansion is 24V-only. A shopper planning a 48V bank, or using a non-Victron inverter, should choose the standard LiTime Bluetooth 24V 100Ah or the Redodo 24V 100Ah (both max 4P2S) or the Epoch 24V 100Ah (max 2 in series, 4 in parallel). None of these three states any inverter communication link on its page.

findings.label: Maximum communicating bank
findings.value: 25.6V 1600Ah (40.96 kWh); up to 16 units viewable in parallel comms mode
findings.source_title: LiTime 24V 100Ah Smart ComFlex Battery | Bluetooth & Victron Comms
findings.note: 1600Ah ÷ 100Ah = 16 in parallel at 25.6V. The page gives no series configuration, so the stated expansion is 24V only. LiTime's 12V ComFlex blog gives '16P1S with battery communication; up to 4P4S in standard installations', but no series figure is published for the 24V ComFlex.
